answer: The horizon assignment is published and dune records each panel. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so someone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the onyx graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 237 impostors cost 847 times the honest price and take 24 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
